description: Safari is open with exactly one tab at the URL 'https://duckduckgo.com/?q=salmon+recipe+2+servings'. Using Raycast, create a Quicklink from the active Safari tab. Convert it into a parameterized Quicklink with the URL template 'https://duckduckgo.com/?q={ingredient}+recipe+{servings}+servings' (use Raycast's dynamic {argument} placeholder syntax with named arguments 'ingredient' and 'servings'). Name the Quicklink 'Recipe Search', pin it, and tag it 'food'. Enable Raycast's 'Prefer Existing Tabs' preference for Quicklinks if it is not already on. Then invoke the Quicklink with ingredient='tofu' and servings='4'. The existing Safari tab must be REUSED (its URL changes to the tofu/4 result) — there must NOT be a new duplicate Safari tab created. Export your Quicklinks collection to ~/Desktop/my_quicklinks.json so the verifier can inspect the saved configuration. End state: exactly one Safari tab open at 'https://duckduckgo.com/?q=tofu+recipe+4+servings' (or equivalent search results URL).
